about.intro: MecaLIK was born from a simple belief: the service should come to the customer, not the other way around. A certified technician, a transparent price, payment after service.
about.whyDesc: We've all been there. The breakdown in the morning, the taxi to the garage, hours of waiting, the unexpected bill. In a city like Casablanca, losing half a day for an oil change makes no sense.
about.solution: MecaLIK solves this at the root. Our certified technician comes to your car, wherever it is. You receive an exact quote before any work. You only pay after the job is done.
about.ambition: Our ambition: to become the reference for mobile car maintenance in Morocco, as the best global platforms have done. Casablanca first. All of Morocco next.
about.value1Desc: Price confirmed before work. No billing surprises.
about.value2Desc: Service in under 90 minutes anywhere in Casablanca.
about.value3Desc: Payment after service. Always. No exceptions.
about.value4Desc: Casablanca today. All of Morocco tomorrow.

faq.pageSubtitle: Everything you need to know before booking.
faq.a1: Describe what you need on WhatsApp or through the site, and you'll get an exact quote in under 5 minutes. Once confirmed, a certified technician comes to you — home, office, or parking lot — and works on-site. You only pay once the job is done.
faq.q2: Which areas of Casablanca do you cover?
faq.a2: We cover all of Greater Casablanca, split into three zones: Zone 1 (Maarif, Anfa, Bourgogne, CIL, Gauthier, Racine), Zone 2 (Ain Diab, Ain Sebaa, Sidi Maarouf, Hay Hassani), and Zone 3 (Bouskoura, Dar Bouazza, Nouaceur, Médiouna). Response time varies by zone but always stays under 90 minutes.
faq.q3: How long does a service take?
faq.a3: Most services take between 30 and 60 minutes depending on the job — 30 min for a diagnostic or battery, 45 min for a wash or tire change, 60 min for a full oil change. Your technician gives you a precise estimate before starting.
faq.a4: Every price is confirmed before the service, based on your zone and vehicle model. You get a detailed quote on WhatsApp in under 5 minutes, no commitment required. No surprise billing: the final amount matches the quote exactly, unless you request extra work on-site.
faq.q5: When and how do I pay?
faq.a5: You only pay once the service is finished and you've approved the work — never before. Payment is made in cash or by transfer, directly to the technician or as agreed with our team.
faq.q6: Are your technicians certified and insured?
faq.a6: Yes. All our technicians are certified and selected for their hands-on experience. Every service is covered by our service guarantee, and technicians carry the professional equipment needed to work safely wherever you are.
faq.q7: What happens if an issue comes up during the service?
faq.a7: If the technician identifies a more complex issue than expected (an extra part needed, an additional fault...), they let you know right away and send a new quote before continuing. Nothing is charged without your explicit approval.
faq.a8: We use parts of equivalent quality to the original (OEM or certified equivalent), sourced from trusted suppliers. If you'd like specific manufacturer-original parts, just mention it when requesting your quote.
faq.q9: Can I cancel or reschedule my service?
faq.a9: Yes, you can cancel or reschedule for free up to 2 hours before the scheduled time, directly via WhatsApp or your customer account. After that, contact us as soon as possible to find a new slot.
faq.q10: Do you offer a warranty on services?
faq.a10: Yes, every service is guaranteed against any defect related to our work. If an issue arises after the technician's visit and is linked to the service performed, we come back to fix it at no extra cost.
faq.q11: Do you work on all vehicle makes?
faq.a11: Yes, our technicians work on all makes and models, including recent vehicles with onboard electronics. For premium brands or specific cases, mention it in your request so we can confirm feasibility.
faq.q12: Can I book for someone else (parent, spouse)?
faq.a12: Of course. You can book a service for someone else — just provide their address and contact details when booking. We coordinate directly with them for the appointment time.
